meta.title: Linux Administrator
meta.tagline: Manage, secure and optimize Linux systems at scale.
meta.description: Linux administrators install, configure and maintain Linux servers and systems. They handle user management, networking, security hardening, scripting and ensure system reliability across development and production environments.
